title: Local-LLM methodology-risk screener for deep-learning medical-imaging papers: code, gold standard and results
description: Code, preregistered test lock, frozen gold standard (120 openly licensed 2025 papers, 5 items with evidence quotes), model outputs and evaluation results for the article 'Can Small Local Language Models Screen Deep-Learning Medical-Imaging Papers for Methodology Risks? A Preregistered Evaluation Against a Human Gold Standard'.
